ModMetaData.name: SkillIcons - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for SkillIcons, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
Written, never run: the two scenarios here only use Pickle's own generic step vocabulary (mod loaded, load order, a def of a given type exists) and need no companion steps assembly. See SkillIcons/docs/TESTING.md for the scenarios that do need a colony and a human to look at the screen.
